---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Rank-Space Organic Versus Acquired Intangibles
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), at), NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), at)))), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(oancf, at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: Both intangible channels matter — self-built knowledge capital is an unrecognized asset and purchased goodwill is an overpriced one — but they are measured on incompatible bases (cumulative expensed outlays versus deal-priced book values), so combining them in rank space rather than in dollars gives a cleaner intangible-quality composite to pair with the cash-flow floor.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The two strongest archived signals are the dollar-netted organic-minus-acquired leg (alpha 4.9%, fmb 5.08) and the pure goodwill-light ablation (alpha 5.0%, fmb 4.59), and the difference form is dominated by whichever component has the larger dollar scale, which is usually booked intangibles. Ranking each channel before combining equalizes their influence and directly tests whether the R&D channel adds information once the goodwill penalty is properly weighted.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Average Versus Worst-Case Cash Backing of Intangible-Light Firms
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), at))), IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)))
HYPOTHESIS: If the archive's repeated success rests on downside insurance — the worst year, not the average year — then replacing the five-year cash-flow floor with a three-year mean should weaken the result; if instead the mechanism is simply that intangible-light firms need cash backing, the mean will work as well and on a much larger sample.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every high-alpha archived signal uses TS_MIN over five years, which is also the binding coverage constraint at 0.091, so we have never separated the "stability/floor" claim in our economic story from a generic cash-profitability requirement. This is a single-design-choice test whose outcome determines whether the final consolidated signal should pay the coverage cost of a five-year floor.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Knowledge Capital Share of Knowledge Plus Obligations
EXPRESSION: IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), ADD(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), lt)))
HYPOTHESIS: The economically meaningful statistic is how large a firm's self-built knowledge stock is relative to the claims other people have on the firm: research capital is only durable if it is not dwarfed by liabilities that must be serviced before the research pays off.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every archived construct is a two-leg conjunction, which makes portfolio composition lumpy and leaves the Fama-MacBeth slope hostage to the MIN kink; this is a single bounded ratio in [0,1] that fuses the intangible stock and the balance-sheet obligation into one scale-free quantity, so it should give a smooth cross-sectional slope and near-universal coverage. It also tests the balance-sheet-quality half of the economic story without a profitability leg, which distinguishes it from the cash-flow-floor family.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Debt-Financed Goodwill Overhang
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), at)), IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Purchased intangibles carried on borrowed money are the fragile combination: the assets produce no collateral value and no near-term cash, while the debt requires servicing, so firms in the joint upper tail of goodwill heaviness and leverage should underperform.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: The archive's short-side attempts used cash-flow constructs (drawdown, accrual-style financing measures) and produced weak or wrong-signed portfolio alphas, whereas the goodwill-light leg has repeatedly been the strongest single intangibles channel, suggesting the penalty is a balance-sheet phenomenon rather than a cash-flow-timing one. Using MIN of two broadly available stock variables gives a well-populated, stable short leg — the specific quadrant the impairment story predicts — without any multi-year cash-flow history requirement.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Patient-Capital Research Commitment
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(dlc, at))))
HYPOTHESIS: Research pays off over many years, so the financing that supports it must be long-dated: an intangible-intensive firm with a heavy short-term debt load faces rollover risk that forces mid-project cuts, while the same firm financed with equity or long-term debt can see the program through.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The archive has tested funding *level* (cash-flow floor), funding *stock* (working capital, retained earnings less debt) and total leverage, but never the *maturity* of the claims, which is the dimension most directly mismatched with a research program's payoff horizon. Short-term debt to assets is available for essentially all firms, so this also delivers a high-coverage test of whether the enabling condition is duration matching rather than solvency.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Knowledge Capital Per Tangible Asset with Cash Floor
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0))))), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(oancf, at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: The right measure of organic intangible intensity scales research capital by the tangible asset base actually employed, so a firm scores high only when its knowledge stock is large *and* its balance sheet is not padded with purchased intangibles, capturing both intangible channels in one economically interpretable ratio.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This is the ratio-form alternative to the rank-space composite in Signal 1 and to the dollar-difference form of the archived leader, and unlike the difference it never lets a large goodwill balance mechanically dominate a modest R&D stock — instead goodwill shrinks the denominator base, amplifying the organic tilt. Pairing it with the unchanged five-year cash-flow floor keeps the comparison one design choice wide, so the batch jointly identifies which algebraic form of the organic-versus-acquired idea deserves to be the consolidation candidate.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---CRITIQUE Rank-Space Organic Versus Acquired Intangibles---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is a third algebraic parameterization of the same two ingredients already tested in the archive (dollar-netted organic-minus-acquired at fmb 5.08 and the goodwill-light ablation at fmb 4.59), paired with the identical unchanged cash-flow floor, so it is a cosmetic re-weighting rather than a new mechanism — and since SUMRANK already equalizes scale, wrapping it in IND_RANK adds little beyond what the two archived legs jointly reveal.

---CRITIQUE Average Versus Worst-Case Cash Backing of Intangible-Light Firms---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: A single-operator ablation (TS_MIN over 5y → MA over 3y) of the archived "Acquired-Intangible-Light Cash Floor" is a legitimate and honestly framed diagnostic, but it is a cosmetic variant of an existing signal rather than a substantively different construct, and its likely outcome — that a mean cash-profitability screen works about as well on more firms — mostly restates the well-known profitability premium.

---CRITIQUE Knowledge Capital Share of Knowledge Plus Obligations---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The construct is internally consistent, bounded, high-coverage and genuinely distinct from the archive's conjunction family, but it is a monotone transform of R&D-stock-to-liabilities and therefore sits close to the well-documented R&D-intensity and low-leverage effects, so the incremental content over a simple rescaling of a known anomaly is modest.

---CRITIQUE Debt-Financed Goodwill Overhang---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The expression and negative expected sign are coherent (MIN is high only in the goodwill-heavy/high-leverage quadrant) and the balance-sheet-only design gives a well-populated short leg, but the target population is essentially "recent leveraged acquirers," which overlaps materially with the published acquirer-underperformance, asset-growth and net-operating-asset anomalies, so any result will need to be shown to survive those controls.

---CRITIQUE Patient-Capital Research Commitment---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: Debt maturity is a genuinely untested dimension in this archive and is the financing attribute most directly mismatched with a research program's payoff horizon, the MIN/rank construction matches the stated conditional hypothesis, and the expected positive sign follows naturally — though the claimed high coverage is overstated since the five-year R&D stock, not dlc, is the binding constraint (~0.09).

---CRITIQUE Knowledge Capital Per Tangible Asset with Cash Floor---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: The expression contradicts its own hypothesis: dividing by (at − gdwl − intan) means a large purchased-intangible balance *shrinks the denominator and raises* the score, so goodwill-heavy firms are rewarded rather than penalized — the opposite of the stated "not padded with purchased intangibles" intent and of the archived organic-minus-acquired result it claims to re-express.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Deal Premium Versus Identifiable Intangibles
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(SUB(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at)), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(oancf, at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: Booked intangibles are not one thing: identifiable intangibles (patents, licences, developed technology, customer lists) are asset-specific and separately saleable, whereas goodwill is the residual overpayment in a deal, so the market's penalty on intangible-heavy balance sheets should fall on the deal premium and not on identifiable intangible assets.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite
REASONING: Every archived intangibles leg has lumped gdwl and intan into a single penalty term, so we have never learned which component carries the information; here the two are separated and netted on a common measurement basis (both are book values, avoiding the expensed-versus-capitalized mixing the critic flagged earlier), rewarding identifiable intangibles and double-penalising goodwill. Paired with the unchanged cash-flow floor, a strong result would say the durable-intangible story is about avoiding overpayment rather than avoiding capitalised intangibles per se, which changes what the final consolidated signal should contain.

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Cash-Flow Stability Rather Than Level Behind Intangible-Light Balance Sheets
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), at))), IND_RANK(NEG(VOL(RATIO(oancf, at), 5))))
HYPOTHESIS: The mandated economic story is that intangible credibility comes from *stable* cash flows; if that is literally true, the second moment of cash-flow-to-assets should validate intangible-light balance sheets as well as or better than a level floor, because stability identifies predictable franchises rather than merely profitable ones.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
REASONING: Every archived quality leg is a first-moment statistic — worst-year level, mean level, industry-adjusted level, loss counts — so cash-flow volatility has never been isolated as a conditioning channel, and the one gen-0 attempt buried it inside an additive SUMRANK that failed for unrelated reasons. Because low volatility and high level are only moderately correlated, this discriminates a risk-stability mechanism from a profitability mechanism, which is a substantive economic distinction rather than a window ablation.

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Research Capital Per Dollar of Capital Employed Including Deal Premium
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), ADD(at, ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0))))), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(oancf, at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: Organic research intensity should be measured against the full capital the firm has deployed, with purchased intangibles counted twice because a dollar of goodwill represents capital consumed with no operating substance; a firm scores high only when its self-built knowledge stock is large relative to a capital base that is penalised for acquisitiveness.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio
REASONING: The previous version divided by assets *less* intangibles, which — as the critic correctly noted — inverted the intended sign by rewarding goodwill-heavy firms; adding purchased intangibles to the denominator instead makes goodwill dilute the score, matching the archived organic-minus-acquired evidence. This gives a single scale-free ratio in which the two intangible channels interact multiplicatively rather than additively, so it tests whether the leader's dollar difference or a properly signed ratio is the better functional form before we consolidate.
